title: Tenured Associate Professor in Econometrics, University of Tsukuba
industry: Economics, Economics and Social Sciences, Econometrics, Statistics and Quantitative Methods (JEL C), Statistics
text:
Job description
Background of the recruitment and description of the project:
The Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences at the University of Tsukuba invites applications for a tenured Associate Professor position in Econometrics
Work content and job description:
1.Master's and Doctoral Programs in International Public Policy, Graduate School of Business Sciences, Humanities and Social Sciences: Teaching specialized courses and seminars conducted in English, supervising graduate students, and assisting with administrative duties related to the English programs.
2.College of International Studies, School of Social and International Studies: Teaching specialized courses, seminars, and introductory courses in Economics, and managing relevant administrative duties.
3.Administrative duties and committees for the Faculty and the University.
Assigned department: Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences
Job type: Associate Professor
Research field: Humanities & Social Sciences - Economic statistics
Wages:
Annual Salary : 7 million yen ~ 9 million yen
Commuting allowance, housing allowance, etc., are available. Social/employment insurance applies.
Working hours: 08:30-17:15
Break time: 12:15-13:15
Holidays: Saturdays, Sundays, National Holidays, and the New Year's holiday period (December 29 – January 3). Annual paid leave is provided.
Overtime and other explanations : This position operates under the discretionary labor system. The standard working hours are 7 hours 45 minutes per day (38 hours 45 minutes per week, 5 days a week). The discretion of determining the actual start/end times and break times is left to the individual faculty member. Overtime work may be required.
Application requirements
Qualifications
Education and Degree Requirements: Ph.D. / Doctor
Key Qualifications:
1.Specialization in Econometrics with an outstanding research record in theoretical or applied econometrics, and the capability to supervise empirical research papers/theses.
2.Hold a Ph.D. 
3.Possess excellent English communication skills, with the ability to effectively utilize them in lectures, education, and research.
Employment Type: Regular employee
Contract period: Tenured - Non-tenure track
Probationary period absent
Work location:
